svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The contract pair gate
svg.desc: One networked fetch fills a cache; the offline gate checks its identity, then feeds the payloads to imago and nucleus.

g.text: The fetch reads both producers and their commits from the pin.
It clones imago and nucleus at those commits, builds imago, and writes the identity record last.
The gate reads the pin and the cache, never the network.
Five identity cases run first: pin, identity record, both checkouts and the binary provenance.
Then imago decodes or refuses each payload, and nucleus verifies the kernel requirement.
Every invocation, payload and report is retained under the run id.
Without go, git or a cached piece, the gate prints SKIP with its reason and exits 0.
A cache fetched for another pin, or a binary that is not the pinned build, fails and names make contract-fetch.
